author: Christopher Lusk, North Echo
limitations: An initial backup attempt failed closed at Fedora xfsdump argument parsing; its snapshot and mount were removed and the 430M failure directory was retained.
The restore drill used a temporary LV on the root NVMe rather than an independent spare disk.
Six ephemeral container attach sockets with overlong paths were discarded by xfsrestore; no regular-file restore error was reported.
The RPM inventory skipped one malformed legacy DSA package-header signature while its SHA-256 and SHA-1 header digests were reported valid.
Bootability from independently restored media has not been tested.
